Biopsy (abd fat pad, rectal, etc.): apple-green birefring w/ Congo red (Se <85% Sp >90%)
If suspect AL: SPEP & UPEP + immunofixation, free light chains, ± BM biopsy
If suspect renal involvement: U/A for proteinuria

If suspect CMP: ECG (<sub>↓</sub> volt, conduction abnl), TTE (<sub>↓</sub> longitudinal strain, LVH, valve & septal thickening, myocard. speckling), MRI (late gad. enhancement). R/o plasma cell dyscrasia; if ⊖ <small>→</small> (99m)Tc-pyrophosphate (PYP) SPECT for TTR. ± Cardiac bx.
Mass spec of biopsy to ID fibril type. Genetic testing to distinguish wt vs. hereditary ATTR.

[Low-dose melphalan + D] if Bor not / tolerated. / Relapse: dara, ixazomib, Bor, or lenalidomide (Blood 2020;136:2620) / AA  Rx underlying disease. Colchicine for FMF, esp. to ↓ renal dis. ?
